description: v3 of the explicit-token-blocks-context candidate. v2 beat baseline (judge 9.42 vs 9.14, success 100% vs 97%, mustContain 100% vs 99%) but cost +10% per run because of the larger system prompt. v3 keeps every fix mechanism from v2 unchanged but trims the prompt by ~21% (19,554 → 15,368 chars), expecting ~10% per-run cost reduction. The trim is concentrated in the EXAMPLES section (7,209 → 3,721 chars, -48%): drops the OP multi-product example c0 (not directly tied to the GUARD), c3 (verdict via 'this monitor' anaphor — c2 covers anaphor + 2.3.b), c5 (no-token + parent CONTEXT — c2 covers it), c6 (LG 34GN850 verbatim — c4's MPG431CQPX already shows the verbatim shape). Six examples retained — c1 (abbreviation 2.1), c2 (anaphor+logistics 2.3), c2b ('Nah' → empty 2.4), c2c (generic question → empty 2.4), c4 (sibling-SKU verbatim 2.2), c7 (sibling-SKU disambiguation MAG 341CQP). The Notes paragraph is condensed from 4 lines to 1 line. STEP 1 § 2 GUARD prose tightened by removing the '[used: …] markers similarly ignored' redundancy (already implied by 'path 2.3 is forbidden'). All fix mechanisms preserved: GUARD blocks parent-context override on explicit tokens; 2.3 vs 2.4 split prevents 'Nah'-style hallucinations; 2.2 alignment rule prevents sibling-SKU collapse. Goals: (1) match v2's judge score (≥9.42); (2) keep all v2's per-subtree wins (subtrees 9, 11, 7, op, msi-purchase); (3) cost-per-run within 5% of baseline (v2 was +10%).

expectations.desiredOutcome: Schema-valid JSON conforming to subtree-identification.schema for every subtree. Every PLAN comment receives an entry, even when products is empty. Per-subtree expectations below pin: (a) the issue 1B case (subtree 9 — must emit LG 34GP83A-B and LG 34GN850 verbatim, not parent's MSI); (b) the v1 hallucination regression (subtree 11 — c1 'Nah' must NOT be resolved to LG 34GS95QE-B); (c) the issue 1A sibling-SKU case (subtree 5 — c5 must emit '341CQP' or 'MAG 341CQP', not 'MPG 341CQPX'). For all other subtrees the default expectation applies.

judge.instructions: Score each candidate on three dimensions, each 1-10. (1) faithfulness — every real product reference is surfaced and no products are hallucinated. Two failure shapes carry extra weight: (i) comments with explicit alphanumeric model tokens (LG 34GP83A-B, LG 34GN850, MSI 341CQP, MSI MPG431CQPX) must emit those products, not silently substitute a parent-chain product; (ii) content-free replies ('Nah', 'lol', 'thanks', short generic questions, meta-disclaimers) must produce empty products — inheriting the parent chain's product into them is hallucination. Verbatim model preservation continues to count: '34GS9QE' must NOT be silently upgraded to '34GS95QE-B'. (2) calibration — contentQuality matches depth per the schema enum: high = substantive evaluation with specifics; medium = verdict or preference without depth; low = product named but not evaluated. Borderline cases err lower. Variant accuracy (MAG 341CQP at 175Hz vs MPG 341CQPX at 240Hz) counts here. (3) completeness — every PLAN comment has an entry even when products is empty; jokes, thanks, meta-replies correctly produce empty arrays without inventing products. Return JSON {candidates:[{candidateId, scores:{faithfulness,calibration,completeness}, rationale}], verdict}. Verdict format: 'best=<id>' | 'tie' | 'none-acceptable'. In rationale, call out subtree-5 (175Hz MSI 341CQP), subtree-9 (LG 34GP83A-B / 34GN850), and subtree-11 ('Nah' content-free reply) specifically and report what each candidate emitted there.

expectations.desiredOutcome: Cheat sheet has both 'MSI MPG 341CQPX' (240Hz) and 'MSI MAG 341CQP' (175Hz). c5 ('I literally just received my MSI 341CQP') and c7 ('I have the 175Hz non "X" model, the 341CQP') must NOT collapse to MPG 341CQPX in c5. Either verbatim '341CQP' OR 'MAG 341CQP' is acceptable. c1 (worry about G-sync on the MSI from OP context) IS legitimately MPG 341CQPX. c2/c3 (generic G-sync questions and disclaimers without product context) should be empty under v3's path 2.4 rule.

Subtree's parent chain has been discussing 'MSI MPG 341CQPX' for several depths, with [used: MSI MPG341CQPX] markers on the AnurinXx PLAN comments. Two PLAN comments name explicit non-cheat-sheet LG products: AnurinXx's 'So I stayed with my LG 34GN850 until now' (c3) and demi9od's reply 'Ha, I am on a LG 34GP83A-B since 2020. Sister monitor to yours.' (c4). Both LG products must be surfaced (verbatim emission is correct since neither is in the cheat sheet). The phrase 'Sister monitor to yours' is an anaphor pointing AT the parent's MSI but does NOT relabel the explicit '34GP83A-B' token.

Subtree contains c0 with two explicit-token products (LG 45GX950A and MSI MPG 321URX) that must be surfaced verbatim. c1 is the regression sentinel: just the word 'Nah' as a reply to a longer LG-recommendation chain. c1 must produce empty products — inheriting LG 34GS95QE-B (or any other product) from the parent chain is the hallucination this scenario aims to catch.
